audit.why: Sion is favoured at 51.13% over 2793 games; the lane is a charge-timing duel, not a damage race. Galio's only escape from a charged Q is Justice Punch (E), 11/10/9/8/7s.
audit.corrected: Early is Sion's on wave cover; levels 4-5 are the cleanest windows; Galio's level 6 is map pressure, not a lane spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Page claims Galio's W taunt 'becomes more punishing' at 6. Shield of Durand does not change at 6 — Hero's Entrance does, and it is 180/160/140s.
audit.why: Riot text: R designates an ally's position, shields allies, knocks up on landing. It is a roam/teamfight tool at 180s rank 1, not a 1v1 spike.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike = Hero's Entrance map pressure (180s at rank 1); lane danger stays the taunt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Galio's passive is an auto-attack reset and the page never says so; Sion's E is never named (Roar of the Slayer) where its armour shred is described.
audit.why: Colossal Smash carries the autoReset flag — the wind-up is the tell to back off, before any ability is cast. Sion's E also knocks a minion back through a line, shredding armour on everything it passes.
audit.corrected: Name the reset tell at Level 1 and name Roar of the Slayer where the shred is used.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown windows are described qualitatively ('once his Q and W are traded') with no numbers.
audit.why: Winds of War 11/10/9/8/7, Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14, Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7 — concrete windows make the advice actionable.

edits.before: Galio's Level 1 kit is only Q poke and his passive magic auto — stand behind minions, save W, and out-trade any early poke attempt with your higher base HP.
edits.after: Galio has only Winds of War and Colossal Smash at 1 — the passive is an auto reset, so its wind-up is your cue to step back; behind minions, out-trade him on base HP.

edits.before: Galio's laning kit runs dry once Q and W are spent; these are the cheapest charged-Q windows in the matchup — force his Justice Punch then immediately step in with the knockup and E shred.
edits.after: Bait Justice Punch (E) — at 8-9s down it is his only exit from your charge; the moment it is gone, hold Q to full for the knockup and follow with Roar of the Slayer's armour shred.

edits.before: Galio's Hero's Entrance adds global pressure and his W taunt becomes more punishing — pre-shield with W before every Level 6 trade or he forces you to auto-walk into his Q burst.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is 180s at rank 1 and buys map pressure, not lane pressure — the duel threat stays Shield of Durand, so pre-shield with W before stepping in or you auto-walk into his Q.

edits.before: Galio's laning kit is front-loaded — once his Q and W are traded, he has nothing left; use those cooldown windows to force your charged-Q knockup freely.
edits.after: Galio is front-loaded — with Winds of War (9s) and Shield of Durand (16s) spent he has only Justice Punch left; charge Q to full inside that window for a free knockup.

edits.before: Galio's W taunt becomes a real threat at 6 — if he lands W, you auto-walk into his Q follow-up; respect it and always pre-shield before stepping in for charged Q.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance (180s at rank 1) makes him a map threat, not a duel threat — the lane danger stays Shield of Durand: taunted, you auto-walk into his Q, so pre-shield first.
